newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan state bank sells 1.38 bln rupees of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan state bank sells 1.38 bln rupees of bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan auctioned three-, five- and 10-year federal investment bonds worth 1.38 billion rupees on Tuesday.
The bank said it had accepted bids of 250 million rupees at par for three-year bonds, 3.5 million rupees at par for five-year bonds and 1.126 billion at par for 10-year bonds.
The auction is set for settlement on Thursday.

In the previous auction on July 11, it accepted bids worth 300 million rupees at par for three-year bonds, 44.5 million rupees at par for five-year bonds and 782.6 million rupees at par for 10-year bonds.
